title: Industrial Research and Development in the United Kingdom: A Survey
note: Preface December 1944, postscript October 1945; first published 1946 (title page reads MCMXLVI), while archive.org records 1945 (the survey date). 401 pp., with frontispiece portrait of Lord Rutherford. Out of copyright. The survey itself contains no bibliography and the OCR derivative drops footnotes; the works listed alongside this record are those it names explicitly with a title and date.

title: Scheme for the Organisation and Development of Scientific and Industrial Research
note: Cmd. 8005, issued 23 July 1915. The founding White Paper that established the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research (DSIR); Heath and Addison reproduce its text in full as Appendix I, by permission of the Controller of H.M. Stationery Office. Cited at pp. 251 and 342.

title: National Water Policy
publisher: Ministry of Health and Ministry of Agriculture and Fisheries
note: White Paper to Parliament, April 1944, presented jointly with the Department of Health for Scotland. Proposed Exchequer grants of GBP 21,375,000 for rural piped water and sewerage and a national water survey. Cited at pp. 187-188.

title: Statistics relating to the War Effort of the United Kingdom
note: White Paper published November 1944; its aircraft-production tables are quoted to show the wartime scale-up that motivated industrial research policy. Cited at pp. 199-200.

title: Statement on Problems of Scientific and Industrial Research
note: Issued April 1944. One of three contemporaneous inquiries that preceded the 1945 White Paper on scientific research; Heath and Addison describe it as a long statement covering many aspects of the problem.

title: Report of the Cotton Board Committee to enquire into post-war problems
note: January 1944, reported to the Board of Trade. Argues for scientific research funding for the cotton industry and reviews the work of the Cotton Research Association.

title: Final Report of the Adult Education Committee of the Ministry of Reconstruction
authors: Adult Education Committee of the Ministry of Reconstruction
note: Quoted at length in the chapter on industrial design (ch. 41) for its account of popular taste and the cultivation of public judgement.
